messages:
jules-marketing: quick note - noticed a steady bump in unassigned inbound leads during APAC mornings (~2.5% today). looks tied to enrichment timeouts.

devin-salesops: can you drop a sample log? want to confirm it's enrichment failing and not RR config.

jules-marketing: snippet copied:
```
2025-11-12T01:14:22Z WARN enrichment service timeout lead=LD-9987 elapsed=3700ms
2025-11-12T01:14:22Z INFO route -> mark enrichment_status=failed and send to unassigned
```

ana-growth: (meant ana-growth) we lowered the TTL to 3.5s last sprint to cut claim latency. APAC HubSpot calls often hit 4-6s under load.

sam-engineering: proposal: implement "fast-path" fallback that on timeout attaches minimal enrichment (email + company) and continues round-robin instead of immediate unassigned. behind feature flag.

devin-salesops: alternative is global TTL bump to 8s but that increases user-visible latency. canary fast-path seems safer.

mike-sdr: please tag fallback leads with enrich_source=fallback_minimal and enrich_error=timeout. saves SDR triage time.

sam-engineering: will emit metrics inbound.enrich.fallback.count and inbound.claim.latency.p95. deploy canary to 10% for 4h. rollback if unassigned_rate not improved or claim_latency p95 increases >10%.

jules-marketing: marketing wants a small dashboard tile: unassigned rate by region + campaign id. devin, can you add a Looker view?

devin-salesops: on it. also scheduling a HubSpot workflow: if enrichment_status=failure and feature_flag=fast_path -> owner=fallback-queue and add property enrich_source=fallback_minimal. hubspot-bot: schedule at 03:00 UTC for canary start.

hubspot-bot: scheduled workflow change enrichment-fallback -> set owner=fallback-queue at 2025-11-13T03:00:00Z (requested by devin-salesops).

sam-engineering: canary deployed to 10% at 2025-11-13T03:02:11Z. monitoring now.

mike-sdr: first fallback lead visible in saved view. tag present. thanks!

jules-marketing: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after the 4h watch and decide promote vs targeted TTL for APAC mornings.
